description: This file defines a structure for the payload used in gateway setup, and contains methods for decoding such payloads from JSON or base64 encoded strings.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload by attempting JSON and base64 decoding.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into a plain string.
